Hi, we're preparing to ship the latest version of our mobile app to the Chinese market and the product team has drafted some release notes in Markdown. Unfortunately, the draft was written by engineers who aren't native Chinese speakers and we've been told it has a lot of professional writing issues — things like inconsistent brand names, mixed punctuation styles, and awkward formatting around technical terms.

Could you please review and rewrite the file `docs/release-notes-draft.md` in the workspace so that it fully meets professional Chinese copywriting standards? Save your corrected version as `release-notes-revised.md`. We need both the cleaned-up text AND a clear summary of what was changed and why, organized so reviewers can quickly understand what categories of issues were fixed.
